scope: existing Photon iMessage operation surface, not every Photon product or provider

operations.purpose: Start or renew a bounded typing indication.
operations.boundary: ttlMs is an integer from 100 to 30000; a resolved control is not device visibility.

operations.purpose: End the applicable typing indication.
operations.boundary: Keep the existing generation-scoped typing controller; do not add another controller.

operations.purpose: Send ordinary text.
operations.boundary: Complete-thought formatting stays in the existing formatter; do not split structured payloads.

operations.purpose: Consume an authorized registered incremental text source.
operations.boundary: Single-use source; progressive versus buffered behavior must come from actual capabilities.

operations.purpose: Send supported formatted text.
operations.boundary: Native rendering and any fallback are provider-specific.

operations.purpose: Send an HTTPS link with optional title.
operations.boundary: A link preview is not a configured interactive app.

operations.purpose: Send one logical group of content.
operations.boundary: content.type=group; 1–8 leaves; grouping is not an atomic send or group-chat creation.

operations.purpose: Send an ordered composition.
operations.boundary: content.type=compose; 1–16 leaves/groups; preserve each earlier accepted part on later failure.

operations.purpose: Read a known message reference.
operations.boundary: The reference must resolve in the authorized conversation and line.

operations.purpose: Reply to one known message with leaf content.
operations.boundary: Use the actual message reference; arbitrary wrapper nesting is not accepted.

operations.purpose: Add a supported tapback to one message.
operations.boundary: reaction is love, like, dislike, laugh, emphasize, or question; not arbitrary emoji in this contract.

operations.purpose: Remove a known authorized reaction.
operations.boundary: Requires its original handle and parent; cold recovery may return REACTION_COLD_RECOVERY_UNAVAILABLE.

operations.purpose: Edit an eligible previously sent message.
operations.boundary: Outbound target only; native edit eligibility applies; no replacement message ID is implied.

operations.purpose: Unsend an eligible previously sent message.
operations.boundary: Outbound target only; native eligibility applies; a void control is not a new message.

operations.purpose: Mark the target inbound conversation read.
operations.boundary: Remote iMessage read is chat-level; this is not proof a recipient read an outbound message.

operations.purpose: Send an existing authorized media resource.
operations.boundary: Use a staged descriptor or attachment reference, not a raw path, URL, or inline bytes.

operations.purpose: Stage bytes from a known inbound attachment.
operations.boundary: Preserve the native identifier and original line; download success is not delivery.

operations.purpose: Send an existing audio resource as a voice note.
operations.boundary: Does not synthesize speech, transcribe audio, or place a call.

operations.purpose: Send a contact card.
operations.boundary: The package shape is name:string, phones:string[], emails:string[]; not the SDK raw contact object.

operations.purpose: Send a poll with a bounded question and choices.
operations.boundary: Use 2–12 {key,label} options; local keys/labels are not native option identifiers.

operations.purpose: Read a known poll through an available native binding.
operations.boundary: Blocked by the reviewed shared-owner Spectrum 12.8.0 binding; not a claim Photon lacks polls.

operations.purpose: Select an option using the authenticated account.
operations.boundary: Blocked in the reviewed binding; never impersonate a human voter or infer native IDs from labels.

operations.purpose: Remove the authenticated account’s selection.
operations.boundary: Blocked in the reviewed binding; the option must belong to the referenced poll.

operations.purpose: Append a choice to a known poll.
operations.boundary: Blocked in the reviewed binding; option is {key,label}, not a poll-option reference.

operations.purpose: Send a card using a registered template.
operations.boundary: Universal static cards, installed-extension rendering and callbacks have separate prerequisites.

operations.purpose: Send a customized card with a registered layout.
operations.boundary: Requires its configured template/extension identity; a URL alone is not registration.

operations.purpose: Update the original card in place.
operations.boundary: Session.cardId must match card.id; missing original SDK session must not create a replacement bubble.

operations.purpose: Resolve an authorized existing conversation.
operations.boundary: Keep the original line; do not choose a default line from a list.

operations.purpose: Create an explicitly authorized conversation.
operations.boundary: New recipients and required provider/line permissions must already be authorized.

operations.purpose: Read a conversation name.
operations.boundary: Read-only; does not authorize a rename.

operations.purpose: Rename an eligible conversation.
operations.boundary: Name is 1–200 characters; native group restrictions apply.

operations.purpose: Read current conversation members.
operations.boundary: Do not expand the authorized recipient set from this read.

operations.purpose: Add explicitly authorized members.
operations.boundary: Native group/dedicated-line prerequisites apply; members is a bounded nonempty string array.

operations.purpose: Remove explicitly authorized members.
operations.boundary: Do not turn uncertain outcomes into repeated mutations.

operations.purpose: Leave an eligible conversation.
operations.boundary: A consequential membership mutation; not a read-only lookup.

operations.purpose: Read the conversation avatar.
operations.boundary: Returned media is still subject to scoped resource access.

operations.purpose: Set an eligible conversation avatar.
operations.boundary: Uses the same guarded media resource contract as attachments.

operations.purpose: Clear an eligible conversation avatar.
operations.boundary: Clear the existing avatar; do not substitute a new media send.

operations.purpose: Set a conversation background.
operations.boundary: Provider and line prerequisites plus guarded media access apply.

operations.purpose: Clear a conversation background.
operations.boundary: No new recipients or sending-line changes are implied.

operations.purpose: Share the sending account’s native contact identity.
operations.boundary: Distinct from contact.send, which sends supplied contact data.

operations.purpose: Send content with a supported iMessage effect.
operations.boundary: content.type=effect; use a schema-listed effect and leaf content; never add a duplicate plain copy.

operations.purpose: Read curated native message metadata.
operations.boundary: Missing delivery/read observations stay unknown; no credentials or full SDK sessions.

operations.purpose: Invoke an already registered, validated custom-content codec.
operations.boundary: resource is a card reference; not arbitrary JSON, an endpoint, executable code or an SDK method name.
